description: This PHP source file defines a Smarty plugin for trimming whitespace from template outputs. It includes functions to process and clean template source code by removing unnecessary whitespace while preserving certain blocks like <script>, <pre>, and <textarea>. The main function performs regex operations to identify these blocks, temporarily replace them, trim the whitespace elsewhere, and then restore the blocks.
external_files: (implicit since it's part of Smarty templating system)

methods.name: smarty_outputfilter_trimwhitespace
methods.description: Main function that processes Smarty template source code to remove unnecessary whitespace while preserving certain blocks like <script>, <pre>, and <textarea> levels.

methods.name: smarty_outputfilter_trimwhitespace_replace
methods.description: Helper function that restores previously removed blocks back into the template source by replacing placeholder strings with original block contents.
